description:
Get workspace audit logs (Enterprise only). Retrieves security, user, and hierarchy activity.
Requires Workspace Owner permissions.

applicability.description: Type of logs to filter by. Required.

end_date.description: End of the range. Supports ISO 8601, Unix ms, or natural language.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (max 100).

start_date.description: Beginning of the range. Supports ISO 8601, Unix ms, or natural language (e.g., "last month", "3 days ago").

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: get_audit_logs
